article.hook: You’re wired to push first and ask later. The South Node in Aries pulls you back from lone battles you don’t have to win alone.
article.lived: For the next year and a half, the impulse to jump in headfirst and handle everything yourself shows up everywhere. Meetings where you dominate the agenda without checking in. Projects you start without looping in teammates. It plays out in quick decisions made before the group’s ready, as if speed alone clears the path. We’re all on edge to prove independence like it’s the only currency - but the clock here is long, so watch the pattern repeat in new settings.
article.turn: The gift is a fierce clarity about what you want and how to act fast. The problem is that fast often means solo - shutting down offers, ignoring hands raised, shouldering more than you need to. Letting go means risking a slower start and a messier middle. But if you don’t, you’re stuck running a race nobody signed up to watch.
moves: At the next meeting, pause and ask who else wants to lead a piece before you jump in.
Invite someone to co-own a small task, then follow through on their lead.
Write down one thing you’re holding alone and tell one person why you don’t have to.
